entries.final_answer: spec-kitty events tail, the ADR 2026-10-13-2 D-2 local subscriber, can follow only a Mission's status.events.jsonl, and its --json flag is accepted but unused (#6611). Operators cannot watch the decision log, run journal, glossary, Op lifecycle or canonical events, and humans get raw JSON with no readable mode.
entries.question: What problem does this Mission solve?

entries.final_answer: See spec.md Success Criteria SC-001..SC-004: --log streams every kind in C-001 from its canonical path (table-driven, red on main); default output is human-readable while --json stays byte-identical to today; --log run selects the latest matching run and refuses typed when none; resume misuse refuses identically on a non-status kind.
entries.question: How will we know this Mission is successful?

entries.final_answer: Out of scope (spec.md C-001/C-004): further log kinds (ops-index, op-closures, propagation-errors, policy audit, archive registry, encoding provenance), a --run-id selector, any EventBridge/write-side work, and any change to the core tail reader. The #5466 coordination-surface fix stays a distinct closed bug.
entries.question: What is explicitly out of scope for this Mission?

entries.final_answer: Human-readable default; --json opts into JSON lines (the docs query --json precedent). The issue prefers implementing a human-readable mode so --json means something; pre-GA 4.0.0rc is the window to flip the default; --json output stays byte-identical for scripted consumers.
options: human-readable default, --json opts into JSON lines (docs query precedent)
entries.question: Should --json stay a JSON-only default (flag dropped as no-op) or flip to opt-in with a human-readable default output?

entries.final_answer: Seven kinds: status (default), decisions, mission, run, glossary, ops, canonical — the kinds the issue's problem statement names plus mission v1 events and the project canonical log. Index/bookkeeping logs (ops-index, op-closures, propagation-errors, policy audit, archive registry, encoding provenance) stay deferred; proportionality ruling from the delivery run's guidance.
options: only the kinds the issue names (status, decisions, run, glossary, ops)
all kinds the #6603 writes gate names, incl. indexes and provenance
kinds named by the issue plus mission v1 and canonical (seven total)
